note: Beat 4 (D99, p001): the six keys of the pose step, with breakdowns authored as poses and two secondaries whose lag, settle and overshoot come from their material (v3/materials.json), not from this sheet.

keys.name: slump
keys.moment: Still bent from the failed joins, the cloak heavy on the shoulders and the light lost on the floor: a held low point.

keys.name: turn
keys.moment: A small sink away from the frame, then the shoulders and head turn toward its light.

keys.name: rise
keys.moment: Stands up out of the cloak, deliberately plumb for the instant she is upright, because the body must land and settle before the cloth does.

keys.name: step
keys.moment: One step toward the frame, the weight travelling onto the lead foot as it lands.

keys.name: threshold
keys.moment: The pause at the frame's edge on one foot, the other heel lifted, stiff and plumb because the body is about to do the gesture no one needs.

keys.name: through
keys.moment: Goes through alone, small in the frame's light, one soft S and no more.
